digest.component_or_area: rebar duration probe CLI and reporting
propositions: Duration probe must be persisted as a reusable, read-only, stdlib-only CLI tool with frozen reproducibility and explicit repository-neutral defaults.
Gated-close phase breakdown must distinguish direct metrics, direct event intervals, and inferred residuals for pre-verifier, deterministic verifier, LLM verifier, and verdict-to-status phases.
Probe must correctly classify no-LLM, forced, status/check/help, unmatched, and interrupted operations separately from completed model-backed cohorts.

Probe implementation was split across rebar_duration_probe.py (thin CLI/reporting layer) and rebar_duration_probe_support.py (rollout/tracker parsing and statistical primitives) to stay within canonical line limits while remaining stdlib-only.
Focused synthetic test suite and import-walk validation must pass without import-time side effects or non-stdlib optional dependencies.
